name: Outbound access protection for Mirrored DBs
description: Outbound access protection is one of the top security asks from the Fabric Enterprise customers. Today WS OAP support only limited set of items which limits the adoption of Fabric for Customers. Our aim is to support Mirrored DBs in OAP so that customers can prevent sensitive data from getting exfiltrated.

result.nameEs: Outbound access protection para bases de datos replicadas
